description:
Get the stored evidence behind one stock's forecast in a graded book: its rank, side, market regime, 5- and
    20-day lookback returns, news items and notes. Use this to see the context a stock was ranked in, and
    get_stock_resolved_history to find which books hold it. An ungraded date, or a ticker not in that book, is an
    error.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, for example AAPL. Upper or lower case both work.
ticker.title: Ticker

trading_date.description: The book's trading date, as YYYY-MM-DD. list_resolved_batches gives the graded dates.
trading_date.title: Trading Date

name: explain_resolved_prediction
title: Explain a prediction
